verdict.rationale: Lithic's docs include an official MCP server that lets AI agents/editors search documentation, inspect endpoint schemas, and execute live API requests directly (lithic-docs-1, lithic-docs-14, lithic-docs-25, lithic-probe-3), which satisfies the 'ai-native exploration with runnable examples' framing. However, there is no evidence of a traditional interactive API reference (e.g., embedded try-it console or OpenAPI/Swagger spec) — probes for openapi.json/swagger.json all 404'd (lithic-probe-2) — so runnable examples are only available via the MCP/agent workflow, not a standard browsable reference page. Missing for 10: a documented interactive API reference UI with inline runnable code snippets, and a public OpenAPI spec for programmatic reference generation.
